items.t: CVT shudder, surging or transmission failure
items.note: Outlander owners were quoted about $7,000-$11,000. Check powertrain warranty and bulletin coverage first.

items.t: Front crossmember rust lets control arm detach (recall)
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Automatic transmission failure on early models
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt or used unit
items.note: Parts figure is for the transmission alone. A used unit can cost less.

items.t: Balance shaft belt failure
items.job: Replace timing belt and balance shaft belt
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $765-$1,141 for the timing belt job on 2003-2006 models. A water pump and tensioners add to the bill.

items.t: Rear suspension clunks and uneven tire wear
items.job: Replace rear lower control arm(s) and align
items.note: One rear lower arm on a later Outlander is quoted around $710-$1,180 at shops. Doing all three arms on a side costs more.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leak and misfire
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket and spark plug tube seals
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $141-$273 for 2003-2010 models.
